mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing methylphenidate metabolism and reducing its efficacy; phenobarbital also causes CNS depression which may counteract methylphenidate's stimulant effects.
action: Monitor for reduced methylphenidate efficacy; consider dose adjustment or alternative stimulant; assess seizure control if phenobarbital is being used for epilepsy management.
